compiled_state.title: Implement ticket-scratch-clear.sh with single-key and whole-ticket modes
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: `scratch clear <id> [<key>]` removes one key or whole ticket scratch directory

## Description

Create plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-clear.sh. With key argument: validates and removes a single scratch file. Without key argument: removes the entire per-ticket scratch directory (recursive). Emits `{status:"ok",ticket_id,key?,removed:<count>}` with exit 0. Removing a non-existent path is a no-op success (idempotent).

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given two scratch files; When `dso ticket scratch clear <id> <k1>` runs; Then exit 0, k1 removed, k2 remains, stdout reports `removed:1`. Given the same setup; When `dso ticket scratch clear <id>` (no key) runs; Then exit 0, entire scratch dir removed, stdout reports `removed:2`. Given a non-existent ticket id; When `scratch clear` runs; Then exit 0 with `removed:0`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] scratch clear with key removes only that key
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-clear.sh
- [ ] scratch clear without key removes whole ticket scratch dir
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-clear.sh
- [ ] scratch clear on non-existent path is idempotent (exit 0, removed:0)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-clear.sh
- [ ] New script and test are executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-clear.sh && test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-clear.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-clear.sh | Create |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-clear.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
